prompt_text:
Match this appearance phrase against ALL anonymous person tiles in the image(s): "the person wearing dark pants with a prominent yellow stripe down the side and a dark top with a light-colored inner layer"
Every labeled tile is one different person from the same video; its two crops are held-out views. Labels and tile order do not reveal the intended target. A phrase may match none, one, or several people. Include ALL people who visibly satisfy the whole phrase in matches. Include in uncertain any plausible person for whom the views do not resolve an attribute, instead of assuming that person is a non-match. Do not pick a best match when several fit. A location or action does not distinguish appearance. Omitted labels mean clear non-matches.
Return {"matches":["P01"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"brief visual explanation"}. Valid labels: ["P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P08"].

message.content: {"matches":["P01","P06"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"P01 and P06 both show dark pants with a prominent yellow stripe down the side and a dark top with a light-colored inner layer. In P01, the yellow stripe is clearly visible on the outer leg, and the top is dark with a lighter inner layer visible at the neckline. In P06, the yellow stripe is visible on the pants, and the dark outer top is worn over a light-colored inner shirt. Other individuals either lack the yellow stripe, do not show a clear light inner layer, or are too obscured to confirm the full description."}
